name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Dialog (header, scrolling body, footer cells) and AlertDialog (an attention cell; focus lands on the safe action): region-framed modals on Base UI. Also installable as @keyline-ui/alert-dialog.
whenToUse: Use it for a task the page must wait for, such as confirming a removal or filling a short form. For detail opened from a list use Sheet; for a quick edit beside a control use Popover.

parts.name: AlertDialogContent
parts.description: The usual confirmation, built from the parts: an attention cell (! or ?) beside the question, optional detail, and two answers on the bottom keyline. Focus lands on the safe answer.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The safe action receives initial focus.

props.name: tone
props.description: The signal of the question: red attention for a destructive action, cobalt for a commitment.

parts.name: AlertDialogPopup
parts.description: The confirmation frame: Base UI's Portal, Backdrop and Popup in one part. A narrower region of rows.

props.name: tone
props.description: The signal of the question: red attention for a destructive action, cobalt for a commitment.

parts.name: DialogBackdrop
parts.description: The scrim behind a modal surface. It fades in with the surface and leaves with it, not after it.

parts.name: DialogBody
parts.description: The dialog's scrolling body: a Keyline Scroll Area. `className` and `style` reach the scroll area itself; `contentClassName` lays out the content (a grid with a 16px gap by default). Fields and groups go here, standalone (2px).

parts.name: DialogFooter
parts.description: Footer: a row of cells (use Button layout="cell") sharing the dialog's bottom keyline.

parts.name: DialogHeader
parts.description: Header cell row of a dialog: title, description, optional close. Reserves the cut's room.

parts.name: DialogPopup
parts.description: The dialog: Base UI's Portal, Backdrop and Popup in one part. A region frame over a scrim, with a header, a body that scrolls and a footer of cells. It carries the configuration (cut, density, motion, theme, dir) of the place it is written, not of <body>.

parts.name: DialogTrigger
parts.description: The element that opens the dialog. Rendered as another part (`render={<Button />}`), the element is that part's and carries its data-slot.
